text:
Nadia: Thanks for the runtime roadmap update. Couple quick clarifications for PMs and on-call: 1) canary timing for kernel-v4, 2) what telemetry fields will be visible to product, 3) concise language on automatic fallback behavior we can copy into release notes.

Omar: Canary window is 2025-08-11 -> 2025-08-18 for a small canary pool. Broader push depends on canary health signals.

Priya: Telemetry: we'll expose per-kernel latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), seq-length buckets, kv-cache hit/miss, and per-node memory deltas. Product tile planned for the Console.

Sam: Fallback behavior blurb we can use: "If a variant exceeds health thresholds, routing will automatically divert to the next compatible variant; this is logged and can be pinned in Console."

Leah: Perf note: v4 has higher transient memory on long sequences; recommend microbatch 8-16 for interactive, batch >=64 for throughput. We'll draft a one-page with recommended batch sizes + cost-per-token ranges.

infra-bot: [notice] 2025-08-12T04:07 - Canary pool alert: elevated OOMs on 80G nodes; 10% traffic diverted to fallbacks.

Omar: Short-term mitigations: reduce pool default batch_size to 16, divert heavy sessions to v3, and throttle prefetch. We'll script toggles for quick rollback.

Priya: Long-term fix: patch to reduce KV preallocation; ETA ~36h. Will publish telemetry endpoints and a per-tenant opt-in histograms doc.

Nadia: Action items: Priya publish telemetry + patch ETA; Sam draft the release-note blurb; Leah produce the PM one-pager and microbatch guidance. Please drop links here when ready.

Leah: Will do, aiming EOD PST.

Nadia: Thanks all, please ping when the docs are up. :thumbsup:
